description: Use to compare companies against each other. Side-by-side headline fundamentals for 2–4 tickers (latest values with as-of context): market cap, close, P/E, P/S, margins, ROE, dividend yield, and 5-year revenue/EPS CAGRs. Uncovered symbols are reported honestly, not dropped silently.

format.description: json (default): the full JSON as text. markdown: a compact table or list, fewer tokens. structuredContent is the full JSON either way.

name: compare_stocks
title: Compare stocks
